    #[test]
    fn test_logical_operator_lexing() {
        let input = "&& || & |";
        let mut l = Lexer::new(input);

        let expected = vec![
            (TokenType::AmpAmp, "&&"),
            (TokenType::PipePipe, "||"),
            (TokenType::Ampersand, "&"),
            (TokenType::Illegal, "|"),
            (TokenType::Eof, ""),
        ];

        for (expected_type, expected_literal) in expected {
            let tok = l.next_token();
            assert_eq!(tok.token_type, expected_type);
            assert_eq!(tok.literal, expected_literal);
        }
    }
}
